description:
LANDED 4c3fa4c63 on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. Cold review with
prototype (approve-with-fixes, folded), adversarial refutation (LAND WITH
FIXES, folded).

THE CHANGE: brands are a conjunctive REFINEMENT FACTOR over the kind axes. A
Descr denotes one rectangle S x B: B over brand-names U {unbranded}, where
`unbranded` is an element every cofinite slot contains and no finite slot
names. unbranded value = brands any(); mint_brand = brands {name};
Descr::none() keeps brands none() as the union identity; NEW
Descr::unbranded() (none() with brands any()) is every value constructor's
base (13 constructors + 9 builder sites re-based). intersect is pointwise
(Meters and Feet = empty: ONE BRAND PER VALUE, a language rule); is_empty =
brands.is_none() || every kind axis empty; union is the pointwise hull, and
asks looks_empty() FIRST so a bottom is the identity however it was reached;
negation is two rectangles; diff is factor-wise and exact on rectangles;
is_subtype is unchanged (diff empty), so `utf8 <: binary` and `Meters(int) <:
int` fall out at every nested position; erase_nominal = brands any() after
the same emptiness test; display and canon render a refinement
(`utf8(binary)`, `not(Feet | Meters)(int)`); bottom has several interned
identities and looks_empty() is the only bottom test (canon collapses every
bottom to fp[none] none, pinned).

RIPPED OUT, same commit: brand_of at three layers; Descr::neg, Types::
complement, SharedTypes::complement (three test users became
difference(any, x); neg_structure stays diff's private helper);
kinds_overlap; erase_nominal's cofinite branch; requires_any's brand
disjunct; the union-style rendering; the duplicated brand_refinement (one
pub(super) function, cofinite double-wrap fixed); structure_eq renamed
same_structure_by_construction.

WHAT IT PROVED: brand_lattice_law 3/10 -> 13/0 and brand_lattice_algebra
5/6 -> 12/0 at unit level (the review's separable probes landed as pins;
every_bottom_is_the_union_identity and erasing_a_brand_keeps_an_empty_type_
empty are the refuter's red-first pins for the regression it found -- with
several bottoms the hull read an EMPTY operand's factors as constraints,
`(int and binary) | Meters(int)` lost its brand, and `Meters and Feet` erased
to a live int). Matrix 485/6/9 -> 491/0/9: brand_refines_its_inner (Elixir
owns the golden; the brand is invisible to it, fz-bsx) and brand_rejects_a_
bare_inner (spec/violation) on three doors. The live defect both ways: M.echo
(binary) handed a utf8 value printed a spec violation and now prints "hi";
Utf8.to_bytes handed a bare binary printed "hi" and now reports spec/
violation; a utf8 flowing through Enum.map into a [binary] spec prints where
base diagnosed. A 29-type battery: reflexivity, transitivity, antisymmetry
up to equivalence, canon injectivity up to equivalence, join/meet bounds,
absorption, arrow contravariance -- green.

MEASURED (597 fixtures, builder and refuter independently): interp stdout
and stderr 0 movers, run 0, canon 0 (469 dumps), --emit=stats 0 outside the
three pull.product counters that move at base too (8 runs, only cache_hit /
displaced / settled on three fixtures); FIFO/LIFO mover set identical (00277,
dead_closure). 0 corpus movers because the library's only brand traffic sits
at RETURN positions and the @spec return side is unchecked (fz-kdt.201).

RESIDUES, EACH OWNED: the union of rectangles (`utf8 | nil` admits a bare
binary; intersect does not distribute over union at the slot, broader than
its pin): fz-kdt.203, pinned known-wrong in a_union_that_disagrees_on_both_
factors_releases_the_brand_slot; diff case 4 over-approximates `(int |
binary) \ Meters(int)` in the sound direction (documented); brands are NOT
erased before the backend -- pass/1 keys twice for utf8(binary) and binary
at base and here: fz-kdt.204; is_disjoint / differs_only_nominally have no
production caller at base: fz-kdt.205; "hi" and <<>> type as bare binary and
a declared return does not mint, so Utf8.from_bytes! is the only minting
path (owner question, recorded here); callable DOMAINS are unchecked at a
@spec argument position at base ((integer) -> int accepted at (binary) ->
int) -- see fz-kdt.201's comment; Enum.map always warns type/no-matching-
clause at runtime:Enum.fz:278 (fz-kdt.185's class); a `case` over a <<>>-
bound variable with a cross-kind pattern dies "backend value 3 is unbound"
at base (see fz-kdt.206). fz-kdt.192 lands next on this base; its X5 pin
flips (display Meters(int); is_subtype(branded, int) true; brand_of line
deleted; verdict accepting) and X5B flips only by 192's own gate.

GATE: Coordinator gate on the folded commit (marker COORD-GATE-1788438783): fmt clean, zero build warnings, clippy clean, lib 1643 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored, fixture matrix single-threaded 503 passed / 0 failed / 9 ignored (six new brand trials), known-red set unchanged.

comments.text: RESEARCH DONE, PROTOTYPED (2026-09-03, proto198.diff, being cold-reviewed). THE ENCODING: brands is a conjunctive REFINEMENT FACTOR over all kind axes -- a Descr denotes S x B with `unbranded` an element every cofinite FiniteSet contains and no finite one names (finite_set.rs unchanged); unbranded int = brands any(), mint_brand = brands {Meters}; Descr::none() keeps brands none() (the union identity), NEW Descr::unbranded() is every value constructor's base (13 constructors re-based; six sites built from none() had silently become the empty type -- two in canon.rs saturate/absorb saturated every DNF axis to top); intersect pointwise (Meters ∧ Feet = ∅: ONE BRAND PER VALUE), diff factor-wise and exact for the three brand shapes, negation two rectangles (Descr::neg now test-only), erase_nominal = brands any() (cofinite branch deleted), display renders a refinement: utf8(binary), not(Meters)(int). Deleted: brand_of at three layers. MEASURED: 13 unit pins red at HEAD / green; lib 1626/0/5; matrix HEAD 485/6/9 (six new brand trials) -> 491/0/9; corpus interp/run/canon 0 movers, executables 5297; the live defect: M.echo(binary) with a utf8 value -> spec/violation at HEAD, "hi" fixed; Utf8.to_bytes(utf8) with a bare binary -> accepted at HEAD, spec/violation fixed (two new three-door fixtures). RESIDUE: a union of brands over DIFFERENT inners loses the pairing (needs a union of rectangles; unreachable: no program has two brands). OWNER QUESTIONS: (1) is one brand per value the model? (2) `int` = "int, branded or not" -- a bare int is not writable in source. (3) THERE IS NO USER-LEVEL WAY TO MINT A BRANDED VALUE: `@type Meters :: refines integer` declares the type but every body producing one returns a bare int, which the argument gate then rejects at any Meters position; utf8 works only because an extern returns any and the return side is unchecked (fz-kdt.201). A minting form (Meters.new/1, an `as` cast, or `refines` publishing a constructor) is a prerequisite for user brands to be usable at all.

title: [BUG] The brand lattice is inverted (int <: Meters, Meters ⊄ int): brands become a refinement FACTOR over the kind axes so the documented law `utf8 <: binary` holds by construction
